mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.config_id = sys_config.uuid AND p.menu_id IS NULL AND p.status = 1 WHERE u.uuid = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 AND ((p.person_type = 2 AND p.user_id = u.uuid) OR (p.person_type = 1 AND p.role_id = u.role_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_role r WHERE r.uuid = u.role_id AND r.status = 1))) )
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, config_key, config_name, config_type, config_value, remark FROM sys_config WHERE status = 1 AND ORDER BY config_key
